name: megascenes-flyer-maker
description: Design a flyer for your event, sale or business with the headline, date, place and details in plain view, on a portrait page.

interface.longDescription:
Give the headline, the date, the place and the details, a party, a yard sale, a class, an opening, a concert, and pick the style. You get a portrait flyer with the information laid out clearly, ready to print or share.

ChatGPT tells you what the design needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The flyer opens in the chat and stays in your library.

For events, local businesses, schools, clubs and community notices.

Limitations: your text is passed to the model as written and the lettering is drawn by the model, so check it in the result; one side per run, as an image. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Design a flyer with your headline and details
Return the flyer in the chat
defaultPrompt: Make a flyer for a yard sale on Saturday at 9 am
Design a flyer for a yoga class every Tuesday evening
Create a flyer for the grand opening of my coffee shop

positive.prompt: Which models can design a flyer here?
positive.expected_behavior: The flyer models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Make a flyer for a yard sale on Saturday at 9 am at 12 Oak Street. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one flyer with the default model needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which model is best for the text on a flyer?
positive.expected_behavior: The models with their settings, to choose one for lettering. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: Make a flyer for a yard sale on Saturday at 9 am at 12 Oak Street. Create it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my flyer on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my flyer to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
